descriptionHtml:
80 × 80cm square. Fleece one side. Canvas the other.

Duddon is a reversible dog bed, one size at 80 × 80cm square, with teddy fleece on one face, smooth-weave canvas on the other and a zipped washable cover.

In January they burrow. Nose under the edge, back pressed into the fluff, and nothing moves until the heating clicks off. Come July that same bed is untouched and they are flat out on the kitchen tiles, because anything fleecy in a warm room is basically a radiator they have to lie on.

Turning it over swaps the surface. Fleece up when the house is cold, canvas up when it is not, and the bed underneath stays exactly the same bed.

What they get

  • Teddy fleece on one face: The surface they burrow into once the heating goes on.
  • Smooth-weave canvas on the other: A flatter, plainer surface for the four months the fleece goes unused.
  • A square 80 × 80cm, all of it usable: No bolster taking a slice out of the middle and no long thin shape to line themselves up with.
  • No walls on any edge: They get on from whichever side they happen to be standing on, at whatever angle suits.
  • A zipped cover: It lifts off for washing, following the sewn-in care label.

Best for: dogs who curl or sleep on a diagonal, rooms that swing from cold to warm across the year, and houses with one bed and no cupboard to store a second.

Why it is worth the money

£119, one size, and what it buys is one bed doing the job of two. The half you are not using is not sitting in a cupboard going stale, because it is underneath them. That is the whole argument for a reversible bed and it is a fairly straightforward one.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

It is not waterproof and we are not going to pretend otherwise. There is no coated outer and no liner sitting under the cover. If accidents have started at your house, this is the wrong bed and one of the wipe-clean ones is the right one.

Size and fit

One size, 80 × 80cm, and the whole square is sleeping area. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. A dog who stretches out in a straight line will overhang a square, and a rectangular mattress suits them better. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Give the fleece face a shake out before you turn it over for the season.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
